def longest_repeated_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    lcs = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    max_length = 0
    end_index = 0

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            if s[i - 1] == s[j - 1]:
                lcs[i][j] = lcs[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                if lcs[i][j] > max_length:
                    max_length = lcs[i][j]
                    end_index = i

    return max_length
